lead_independence.headline: Fort Pierce approves $10.1 million Axon contract for police body cameras, AI tools
lead_independence.lead: The Fort Pierce city commission on Monday, Sept. 14, voted unanimously 5-0 to approve a $10,139,037.87 contract with Axon Enterprise, Inc. for body-worn cameras and other technology for its police department. The contract runs for five years with an optional automatic renewal for another five years.
